item.coloph: de ni don dam shrI he ru ka mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis dngos po'i don nyid kyis ji ltar gzigs pa de ltar gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang ge gnas su gshegs pa'i tshe skyi shod gnyi thang bkra shis dpal gyi na mo cher rdo rje'i glu blangs pa rdzogs so
